meta_description: N&J's Towing, LLC serving North Myrtle Beach - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: A higher standard of towing in North Myrtle Beach.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
footer_blurb: N&J's Towing, LLC serving North Myrtle Beach.
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers powersports and small equipment, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of North Myrtle Beach and the towns around it.
area_h2: Where we take on towing work near North Myrtle Beach

reviews.author: Autumn Grace
reviews.text: The ABSOLUTE BEST towing experience of my life! We had traveled from out of town in a rental car without a spare and got a flat tire. We were stranded on the highway on Sunday, April 19, 2026. Joe was a lifesaver! There are not enough words to describe how he helped us out and how grateful we were. HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend this company for all of your towing needs. Kind, Professional, Quick Response time. An all around good human being.

reviews.author: Dolores McConville
reviews.text: Oh boy!! What a morning. I needed a jump start. I called my road side assistant. They dispatched another company that decided not to show up after I waited over an hour and a half. Well N&J was dispatched to replace the first company. The driver was there in less than 20 minutes. Thank you so much. Moving forward anytime I need a tow truck I will be calling N&J… awesome customer service and so friendly.

reviews.author: Dana Zeller
reviews.text: Affordable and Quick! Can't thank this location enough. This mama was freaking out trying to get my kid home by Monday for work and they got his car to the shop quick. Highly recommend!!! The lovely office lady was awesome to talk to as well!

reviews.author: Automotive PhD
reviews.text: Best experience i ever had with towing company. Joe answered the phone and said he will be by us in 25 minutes, while other companies were giving me tons of excuses why they can not come out. Well, Joe arrived in 20 minutes and did an outstanding job recovering our vehicle . He safely loaded already damaged vehicle on the flatbed making sure there is no other damage occurs while loading it. He did same thing unloading the vehicle at our house. I am very happy and will use this company for all my needs from now on. Thank you , Joe and Thank you N & J Towing !

reviews.author: J Leigh
reviews.text: N&J sent a driver within 30 minutes of my call at 7:30 in the morning! The service was quick, too, and the price was beyond fair; they are a great company with a great team!

reviews.author: Hunter Pearce
reviews.text: The best people ever. I mean it. Respectable, dependable, reliable, honest, and fair. I couldn't have got my truck home without them. Thank you so much! Give these folks a shot, they deserve all the business.

reviews.author: bethany favors
reviews.text: I was on the way to Myrtle Beach when my Hyundai Sonata broke down, started blowing smoke, and getting sluggish. My friends and I called this tow company, and they sent Rich out for the tow. He was very quick getting to us, and even gave us a ride along with my car. All was well until he quite literally dropped my car off of the tow truck...yeah. Joe, the owner, was quite easy to work with. Called me immediately after it happened, and paid for the damages. Just be careful who they send out to tow your car. Red flag especially if the driver tells you hes only been towing cars for two months and came from the restaurant industry. Easy to work with but not very reliable.

reviews.author: Meredith Poole
reviews.text: I can’t thank these guys enough, great service! Even though they had an issue themselves, they kept me informed as best they could. My first towing experience, and they handled everything for me! Even got a message later wishing me a better week! 10/10! Thank you Joe!

reviews.author: J Disbrow
reviews.text: I called AAA for road side assistance on Saturday. They dispatched a tow truck that never arrived even though I received a test stating that it was on site. Never showed. I called them back and they had no idea why he was a no show. They then dispatched N &J towing. I let them know that I was requesting an unaccompanied tow and I left my vehicle. I received a call from Jack, the driver, he kept me informed with everything he did including getting my car started, testing the battery and alternator. He then flat bedded it to my preferred service station. He assured me my car was secured and in the drop box. Thank you Jack! If N&J had been dispatched first, I wouldn’t has spent 3.5 hours sitting in my car!

reviews.author: Jennifer Rosander
reviews.text: Out of all the towing companies I called. They were three times as much and 2 1/2 hour wait I called NNJ’s they were there within 15 minutes. Nice driver felt really comfortable with them. Definitely recommend them- the service was right on point fast and quick when I was overwhelmed and stressed out my car died. It was nice to know they were right there.

reviews.author: Jasmin Lane
reviews.text: My tire split open on my way to work this morning. I requested roadside assistance through my insurance and they dispatch N & J Towing. They arrived faster than any towing company I’ve ever worked with. He was so nice and kept telling me it was ok to sit in my car to stay warm until my mom arrived. He loaded my car up safely and delivered it to the shop so that I could get my tire replaced. I will be using this company for any towing needs in the future. Thank you N&J !

reviews.author: Jeannette Price
reviews.text: CalledN&J’s Came out very quickly. The two drivers were very kind. And good at what they do. PRICE was very good. If I need another tow truck, I’m sure I will. I know my Car I will be calling only them fantastic service fast and good service thank you

reviews.author: Ligia Cisneros
reviews.text: I’m so grateful for the incredible help from N&J Tow Company! J went above and beyond to find me even after Mercedes roadside assistance gave him the wrong address. He was so patient, respectful, and genuinely cared about making sure I was safe and taken care of. Excellent service professional and kind.. Truly 5 stars! I Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rick Huska
reviews.text: My new BMW X5 wouldn't allow access. Called BMW Roadside Assistance and NJ Towing responded quickly. The representative, Joe, was responsive, communicative on estimated arrival time and completely courteous and professional in towing my car safely to the BMW dealership. Couldn't have asked for any better service. Thank you Joe and NJ Towing

reviews.author: Ronald Henderson
reviews.text: It was a long delayed for any towing service to respond to my rental roadside request. Once N&J got the assignment, they responded within the hour after giving me an eta. Joe was friendly and efficient. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Michael Fornal
reviews.text: Great service from start to finish. Joe the owner was very quick to get truck to me. Rich took care of the tow like a pro. Friendly, quality service!

reviews.author: Cameron
reviews.text: I used them to move my Toyota Sequoia. After a few places told me no due to some issues with the vehicle, N&J pulled through! He was fast and helpful. Will definitely use this service again. Fair prices too.

reviews.author: Brian Britt
reviews.text: Great customer service….prompt service…took great care of my vehicle as well as personal property within…delivered to destination location as promised…highly recommend to anyone in need of a roadside service in the Myrtle Beach area!!!!

reviews.author: Erica Wright
reviews.text: Omg, this was the best service from a tow truck company I have ever had they went above and beyond to help me when my radiator went out on me on Hwy 57 yesterday. Thank you so much

reviews.author: Mauren Warden
reviews.text: I unfortunately got a flat tire on a super hot day while 7 months pregnant and didn’t have a spare with me. I couldn’t get ahold of the national roadside assistance company I’ve used before, but Joe responded immediately when I called and was able to get me to a repair shop within an hour. He was warm, kind, professional and so helpful. I was so impressed with him and the way he runs his company. I honestly don’t know how long I would have had to wait on the side of the road without him and will be forever grateful for his quick and wonderful help

reviews.author: Aj Duke
reviews.text: Late last night, my car broke down in SC on Hwy 31. I waited over 2 and a half hours for my roadside assistance through my insurance company to show up, but they were a no show, no text or call. So, Finally I had to call a local tow company, N &J's Towing. Joe arrived very fast to my location. He was very kind, patient, professional and understanding. He got my car back home to NC. I arrived to my house as Joe was fixing to leave after dropping my car off. He got out and said bye to us and had my car parked perfectly in the driveway. I'm grateful to have had such a pleasant experience with Joe and N & J's Towing. Hope I never need them again but if I'm in that area and do need a tow, this will be the only company I call. I highly recommend this company! Thank you for just being a kind professional!

reviews.author: Jeff Sgroi
reviews.text: N&J's Towing is a first class act. Very professional and extremely courteous. Joe is a super nice guy. Totally makes sure you are pleased with their service. Highly recommended!!!!!!

reviews.author: Ray Plymette
reviews.text: Was out of town in Myrtle Beach for the weekend and ended up having a flat tire after running over a pothole. I gave Joe a call and he responded extremely fast, towed my car and dropped me off at the mechanic. He was kind, knowledgeable, and professional. Could not have asked for a better experience. Thanks Joe!

reviews.author: Joe Ballano
reviews.text: Last time I need a tow, THREE companies turned down the business from USA*, and I waited 9 hours for a tow. This time I waited less than a 1/2 hour and N&J towed it to the specific shop I requested and called to let me know it was there. Nichole and her Husband own and run this business, so I am especially happy to work with locals (buy/use LOCAL) In the future I will ONLY call them, and I recommend you do as well....:)

reviews.author: Sarah Putnick
reviews.text: The driver showed up rather quickly and he was very kind. I hadn't been so lucky in the past. I have needed my vehicle towed a few times in the past couple of years (newer ford fusion, terrible electrical problem) The last Towing Company I had (won't mention), the driver was very rude (couldn't get my car in neutral) but this driver knew exactly what to do. Thank you N&J's for making this a little easier.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Biggins
reviews.text: My daughter was coming home from a long trip and got a flat tire on the driver side. It was the spare tire as she had a flat tire earlier in the trip. She called AAA for a tow. This was around 8:30pm. She was on the side of the road. AAA took two and a half hours to finally tell her there was no tow available. My wife called N&J’s Towing as I was waiting with my daughter. N&J’s came right out and towed the vehicle to my house. I would recommend N&J’s Towing if you need your vehicle towed after hours.

reviews.author: Cathy Hesseltine
reviews.text: I wish I could give 10 stars! Service was impeccable. Joe took every one of my 6 phone calls. No voice mail or robots. Joe turned my stressful situation into a pleasant situation. And the price was very reasonable. Thank you Joe!

reviews.author: kayson hilliard
reviews.text: I locked my keys in my car this morning and the lady that helped me was phenomenal! She arrived very quickly and was able to get my keys out for me. After she opened my car, it wouldn’t crank (security feature) and she knew exactly what to do. Thank you so so much!

reviews.author: Glen Todd
reviews.text: My car failed..call my Allstate roadside service... They dispatched j&n towing... Joe the driver arrived quickly was very professional and courteous.. would recommend this business to anyone. great service!!

reviews.author: Christine Burtis
reviews.text: They are very good. I recommend them 10 out of 10. They care about your car when they are towing it. They are very nice and professional.

reviews.author: Jeff Loggins
reviews.text: We were on vacation in Myrtle Beach. Came out of restaurant Fri night, car w/n start or do nothing. Before towing Sat, morning, he got car started so I could get to parts store. We made iit home Sat night.

reviews.author: Patrick Clouse
reviews.text: Fantastic customer service and very polite. Checked all four tires which wasn’t expected and gave some helpful advice. Top notch service - best in MB!

reviews.author: Sunni Shaurette-Stubbs
reviews.text: Lady who answered the phone was super friendly & the gentleman she sent out was fast & very polite!! Would definitely recommend this company a million times over!!! Thank y’all so much!!

reviews.author: Desera Smith
reviews.text: Tell your drivers not to be rude to other drivers and honk their horn just because they're trying to figure out exactly which turn to make! So rude. Plenty of other tow companies out there!
